title: Basic Amigurumi Ball
description: A small stuffed sphere for practicing increases, decreases, and working in continuous rounds.
expectationText: A compact shaping project where increases build the curve, straight rounds add height, and decreases close the form.

steps.title: Start the center
steps.instruction: Make a magic ring and place a stitch marker in the first stitch of each round.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 6 single crochet into the ring and pull the center closed.

steps.title: Rounds 2 to 4
steps.instruction: Increase evenly each round until the piece starts to cup into a rounded shape.

steps.title: Rounds 5 to 7
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without increasing to build the middle of the ball.

steps.title: Rounds 8 to 10
steps.instruction: Decrease evenly each round, adding stuffing before the opening gets too small.

steps.title: Close
steps.instruction: Fasten off, thread the tail through the final stitches, pull closed, and hide the end inside.
